Container.Name: Lingle
Container.Overview: Lingle is a self-hosted word guessing game in the style of Wordle, with a language selector. One puzzle per language per day, the same word for everyone on your network, rolling over at local midnight. Ships with Russian and English. Once a puzzle is over it shows the word's dictionary entry - for Russian, the English meaning plus the stressed spelling - which makes it useful for a language you are learning. The server holds the answer and scores every guess, so the word is not sitting in the browser waiting to be read out of devtools. Progress and streaks are kept per browser in a small SQLite file. Nothing is sent outside your network.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the game is served on. Browse to http://[TOWER-IP]:[PORT]

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Holds lingle.db - in-progress games and per-browser streaks. A few hundred KB.

Config.Name: Default language
Config.Description: Language a first-time visitor gets: ru or en. Players can switch in the settings menu, and their choice is remembered.

Config.Name: Available languages
Config.Description: Comma-separated allow-list of language codes, for example: ru,en - leave empty to offer every installed pack.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Decides when the daily word rolls over. Set this to your own timezone.

Config.Name: Title
Config.Description: Text shown in the page header. Leave empty to use each language's own name.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the server runs as. 99 is unRAID's 'nobody'.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the server runs as. 100 is unRAID's 'users'.
